note: The plan has captions only under his voice and one ask text at the end. Use these only if Dwayne or Nick asks for more, and keep the sinks and stall doors in view.

mg.title: The truth be seen

text.main: And we're ready to let the truth be seen.

mg.use: Over the slow push to the stall door as he says it. Keep it up through the 0.5 s of air after “seen”.

mg.title: Not visible

text.main: And just like I'm not visible in this video, they become invisible to many of our public officials.

mg.use: Over the stall doors as he says it. Hold 0.5 s after “invisible”. Keep captions on.
